verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs say designers can paste frames and components from Figma designs into the chat, attach several designs as guidance, and attach Figma frames or PDFs, so importing an existing design is first-party and direct. The docs present attached designs only as 'guidance' for the model, though, and nothing shows the builder faithfully implementing an imported file end to end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-file import and of design-to-code implementation fidelity, and independent or hands-on corroboration that imported designs are implemented accurately.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: You can also paste frames and components from your designs directly into the chat.
You can attach more than one design to help give the model more guidance.
Bring in design systems using Make kits and npm packages, or attach Figma frames, PDFs, and more.
Everything you build is code-backed and visually editable, so you can easily jump between code and canvas.
